reviewer: Kimi main recovery executor actually viewed the exact source and NEAREST 8x detail, complete unchanged raw, full white/cyan/source-alpha/return-alpha sheet and unchanged naiwa reference; checked hair, pose, collar, note edge and gray groups, and verified evidence/source/output/task/prompt/request/result/sheet bindings with read-only Python.

remaining_reasons: The large note-edge notches are corrected, but the note substitutes four short dashes in each upper row for the source's separated irregular gray-mark groups. Restore the source's visible group count, irregular relative lengths and compact two-row footprint rather than a generic eight-dash pattern or readable writing.

hair_features.reason: Short brushed-back dark hair, receding temples, short sideburns and dark brows remain, with no added beard or glasses.

collar_fit.reason: The rounded chin meets the standing collar through a short broad fitted transition without a stalk or pinching.

entries.positive_observation: The previous two large right-edge notches are gone; the note edge is continuous with slight wear and retains a small dark tab. The yellow mascot retains green-ringed black eyes, one stern mouth, short dark hair/brows, two mustard-gold collar details and one dark tie. The frame/backplate and blank lower paper remain; white/cyan viewing shows no visible interior holes or lost backing.
entries.alpha_decision: Native RGBA and white/cyan comparisons show no visible interior hole or working-matte halo, and the note exterior is improved. Internal 252-254 values are not rejection grounds. The remaining generic eight-dash note substitution is an RGB art defect, so this is not production-approved.
entries.visible_limitations: The two tiny collar motifs and note glyph identities cannot be read reliably at 65x67. The rejection is for the clearly changed gray-mark group pattern, not guessed writing or microscopic insignia.
